principles: Deterministic scripts execute tests; AI never decides PASS or Physical PASS.
Every physical run is bound to the exact release ZIP SHA-256 and freshly collected evidence.
AI is invoked only for a normalized failure packet after a deterministic stage fails.
A repair creates a new artifact SHA and invalidates prior physical certification for release purposes.
Open-source product dependencies are installed by the product installer from immutable bundle inputs; the lab does not replace product ownership with ad-hoc manual installs.

serverTiers.purpose: One single-node Factory management appliance plus one Compact-3 OKD target for import, reconnect and revocation certification.
notes: The lab runner itself can execute from an operator workstation and is not counted as a server.
If a real existing OKD cluster is already supplied, only the management server is additional.
resourceSummary: Management node: 4 vCPU / 16 GiB RAM / 100 GiB free disk (4SO lab floor; above RKE2 minimum to leave headroom for PostgreSQL, Forgejo, zot, Keycloak and control-plane workloads).
Each OKD control node: 4 vCPU / 16 GiB RAM / 100 GB storage / 300 IOPS minimum; faster etcd storage is recommended.

providers.use: bounded diagnosis/repair with explicit turn and budget caps
preferred low-token structured failure diagnosis through the unified platformctl AI runtime; use a cost-efficient model first and escalate only after unresolved product-defect classification
self-hosted/vLLM or compatible endpoint through the unified platformctl AI runtime
interactive/subagent investigation through a custom command adapter

aiPolicy.egressPolicy: central redaction before every provider; bounded JSON context; raw prompts and credentials are not durable authority
aiPolicy.durableAudit: successful model calls become project-scoped ai_runs with prompt/context/output digests, token usage and redaction count
aiPolicy.executionAuthority: AI is advisory only; all changes continue through deterministic product plans, RBAC, approvals and durable operations

mcp.authorization: authentication + dedicated capability scope + project authorization for project-scoped resources

runner.targetHostSSHPolicy: Phase C uses root SSH only for management roles; existing OKD target nodes are not required to permit root SSH for import certification.
runner.bundlePolicy: Run requires a verified immutable appliance bundle until canonical automatic digest-locked acquisition is implemented; absence is BLOCKED, never latest-download fallback.
runner.physicalPassPolicy: No individual runner stage, AI diagnosis, MCP call or management install alone may produce four-layer Exact-SHA Physical PASS.
